plan: One meadow screen where bubbles drift up and pop into sparkles and a soft note on any tap, plus a sleepy goodbye scene; dusk bubbles, splitting bubbles and light blossoms are left out.
Six friends hide behind clover, fern and blanket covers and appear with a voiced peekaboo on any tap, ending with a yawning goodnight; parent voice recording and longer suspense steps are left out.
Nine wild animals on two habitats, each entering on a tap with its call and a voiced name; the listening guess mode and the night wood habitat are left out.
Eight pentatonic chime stones plus a log drum, each tap ringing a note and blooming a flower, with a bird that answers; extra instruments and the parent play-along song mode are left out.
One basket that pops out eight springy toys in turn on any tap, each with its own bounce and sound, and a goodnight clean-up where the toys climb back in; hide-again tricks are left out.
One pond where a tap on the water makes one of six colored fish leap from that spot, wave and splash home, ending at sunset; the frog, turtle, night pond and bubble window are left out.
One night meadow where taps sprinkle humming stars and fireflies over a sleeping fawn while the lullaby slows and the screen dims by itself; star pictures and the shooting star are left out.
One canvas where any finger smear paints thick sparkly color from five big pots, a clear-and-start-over button and a keep-for-parents save; stamps, sound paint and the meadow gallery are left out.
A toy meadow where each tap sends the next of eight toy vehicles past with its sound and voiced name, ending in a goodnight parking row; the sound guessing mode and sky-lane glider are left out.
Three short original songs on one hill where each tap starts the next sung line and the friends clap and sway in time; the slow parent mode and the full songbook are left out.
Two themed sets of twelve picture leaves (home and animals), each tap bouncing the picture with a voiced word and a big next arrow; the pointing mode and parent voice recording are left out.
Ten meadow line drawings with three to six large parts, filled by tapping after picking from five paint drops, each finished picture doing one small animation; rainbow brush and album are left out.
Nine pictures cut into two, three or four straight pieces with glowing slots and generous snapping, each finished picture coming alive; tab-shaped pieces and the finished-puzzle meadow are left out.
Linky on a picnic blanket with seven plant foods, two at a time on a leaf plate, dragged to its mouth for munch animations and voiced names; other hungry friends and sharing mode are left out.
Three washes of the muddy fawn with a sponge rub that clears mud into bubbles, a rinse tap and a towel shake; other friends and floating bath toys are left out.
The baby otter with four big teeth brushed by rubbing to a short brushing song, rinse and smile, plus a brush-along screen; extra animals and a brushing timer are left out.
One large fawn with eight tappable body parts, each wiggling with a voiced name, and Linky copying the move; the where-is mode and the duck and frog are left out.
Four muddy train cars washed one at a time with soap rub, cloud rinse and warm-wind dry, rolling off shiny; the boat, bike and balloon washes are left out.
Three seed bumps that grow over five watering taps into a sunflower, tulip and pea vine, with the garden kept between sessions; seasons, visiting bees and new seeds are left out.
One meadow building spot with eight chunky ringed blocks and a glowing crown block, soft tumbles and a reset; round blocks, sitting friends and two linked towers are left out.
Six hide-and-seek rounds in two meadow areas with two to three big hiding spots and a wiggle and glow hint; switching turns so the child hides Linky is left out.
Six bedtime steps in a fixed order, each one big glowing object tapped in turn, ending with the lights fading and the app closing; parent step reordering and extra friends are left out.
A sorter box with round, square and triangle holes and six rounds of shape friends sliding back with a giggle at the wrong hole; star and heart holes and the picture mode are left out.
Four weather scenes with two clothing choices each dragged onto Linky and voiced kindly whatever is chosen; two-change walks and the fawn and duck are left out.
Eight big-and-small pairs given to a deer and her fawn or a duck and duckling by tapping, with a happy dance; three-size families and grow-and-shrink play are left out.
Six rounds sorting fallen treasures into two then three colored baskets, each color also carrying a shape; four colors, light and dark and color mixing are left out.
Six animal families where a baby is dragged to its mama among two then three choices for a hug animation and voiced names; homes and the call-and-answer mode are left out.
Eight rounds matching a bright object to one of three soft gray shadows on a lattice screen, each turning colored and waving; wiggling shadows and shadow puppets are left out.
Nine counting rounds from one to three with fawns, ducks and apples, each tap hopping an item as a voice counts and a dot lights; basket choices, feeding and counting to five are left out.
Six feelings shown by Linky in the pond, chosen from two big face bubbles, plus an optional parent mirror that is never saved; feeling scenes with other friends are left out.
